title: Silent Signals, Loud Impact: LLMs for Word-Sense Disambiguation of Coded Dog Whistles
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the ability of LLMs to detect and disambiguate 'dog whistles,' which are forms of coded discriminatory language. While the research includes categories for religious groups (such as Islamophobic and anti-Semitic speech), its primary focus is on the NLP task of detecting sociopolitical prejudice and hate speech rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious doctrines, moral systems, or ethical frameworks.
